title: Style lint in csnotes check (PI-PLAN Phase 3, no Pi needed)
description: PI-PLAN.md Phase 3. Backend-independent; helps the Claude backend now. Per atomic note outside the intro: paragraphs over N sentences, prose lines outnumbering bullets, configurable banned phrases (style.banned_phrases). Warnings by default, style.strict blocks exit. file:line output. Stays deterministic/offline (R5). ~half day; good break-sized task.
